Containers.Name: unCommander
Containers.Description: unCommander is a two-pane, Midnight Commander-style file manager for the unRAID web UI. Browse two folders side by side and copy, move, rename, delete, compress, extract and compare files with taps or F-keys. Copies and moves run in the background with progress, deleted files go to a restorable trash, and most actions can be undone. Includes batch renaming with live preview, a file viewer and editor, folder sizes, archives that open like folders, practice mode, an optional whole-system view, and tools to find empty folders, movie folders missing their video and TV shows with missing episodes.
